lines.explanation: Read-only profile check; active regardless of resolution status.
Read-only search for channels discussing the topic; active despite underspecified referent set.
Conditional gate depends on the read-only finding in L3; the condition itself is active to evaluate.

This state-changing action is nested under the L4 conditional; whether it is active depends on the outcome of the underspecified 'this topic' resolution (L3/O4), which itself is underspecified—no candidate set is authorized to be chosen without user input, so creating a channel based on an arbitrary reading of the condition is not authorized by the task specification's own terms. Per rule 4, this state-changing action's directly linked grounding obligation (O4) is underspecified, marking it inactive.
State-changing action with a resolved grounding obligation (core-infra) and clear semantic content (heads-up about debugging plans); active.
State-changing reaction action whose linked grounding obligation (O6, resolving Aisha's specific intended message) is underspecified among six candidates; per rule 4, inactive.

State-changing removal action whose two linked grounding obligations (O7: person no longer on team, O8: project channel) are both underspecified with no enumerated candidate sets; per rule 4, inactive.
